text:
mara: heads-up — hitting a flaky bug in the sampleapp rerank path. JS SDK retry + auth failure occasionally results in embeddings of length 1025 instead of expected 1024, causing rerank to crash.

jin: 1025? that screams off-by-one padding. where is the extra value coming from?

mara: looks like the retry handler rebuilds batch payloads after a 401 and sometimes an extra null/zero floats onto the end of one vector. repro is inconsistent but seen in about 1/5000 batches.

sam: can you paste the raw request you captured (keys redacted)?

mara: captured payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model":"embed-lite-1",
  "inputs":[[0.12,0.03,...,0.0]], /* length observed 1025 */
  "meta":{"session":"onboard-xyz"}
}
```

lina: interesting. our Python batch helper does an explicit trim/pad to 1024. JS code uses TypedArray.concat and Buffer.concat in the retry flow — maybe Buffer.concat adds an extra zero byte that becomes a float when parsed.

mara: also saw the client assume response.embeddings.length === inputs.length and zip them, so when shapes mismatch downstream logic blows up.

jin: two issues then: (A) retry path corrupts vector length, (B) response envelope doesn't provide embedding_dim metadata so clients can't validate shape.

sam: short-term workaround: add a client-side guard in the sampleapp to assert each vector length === config.dim before sending and fail loudly.

mara: I added a local pre-send sanity check and it prevented the crash. but we need SDK parity fixes. lina, can you add an assertion in JS SDK batcher to throw on unexpected dim?

lina: yes. default behavior: throw and log. add an option to auto-trim for callers who prefer silent fix.

jin: also recommend adding idempotency-key header in sampleapp to avoid duplicate processing during retries. that helped for dup sends but didn't fix padding.

mara: I traced it to a Buffer.concat path during retry where an extra 0 byte slipped in; when converted to float array it becomes an extra 0.0.

sam: I'll open an infra trace to capture the 401->retry payload diffs at the proxy so we can compare original vs retried payloads. deploy-bot: start debug trace sampleapp embed-dim-repro

deploy-bot: debug trace started id t-1776450000-repro

jin: add a unit test in JS SDK to simulate auth-fail + retry that asserts vector lengths are preserved. put it in CI.

mara: pushing a mocha test and a tiny CLI command `ri embed-inspect --show-lengths` to print batch vector lengths before send.

lina: server-side change: include `embedding_dim` and `model` in response.embeddings envelope so clients can validate. I'll draft a short RFC for the change.

sam: once server returns dims, clients can catch mismatches earlier and give better error messages instead of silent index errors.

mara: plan of action: (1) mara adds sampleapp guard + test branch, (2) lina updates JS SDK batcher to error on bad dims and add opt-in auto-trim, (3) jin updates sampleapp README to recommend idempotency-keys and retry-safe patterns, (4) infra inspects proxy traces. I'll post PR links in #devex.

lina: starting branch `lina/js-embed-dim-guard`.

sam: created infra ticket DEVEX-1137 to collect traces, I'll tag the rerank service owners.

mara: PR pushed `mara/embed-retry-dim-guard`, tests added. pinging for review.

jin: thanks for triage. leaving trace open for 48h.

deploy-bot: trace t-1776450000-repro will expire in 48h.
